name: Tatebayashi (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tatebayashi city emblem in white: an outlined four-lobed device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tatebayashi, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 June 1956.

features.role: Tatebayashi city emblem — an outlined four-lobed device enclosing a stylised character
